answer: Each identity must mint a copper relic under a willow, and the k-th relic costs the k-th pentagonal number of copper coins: the first pays 1, the second 5, the third 12, the tenth 145, so ten identities pay 550. Every relic also needs a distinct willow root, and roots are scarce: the hundredth fake must plant a new willow and wait one full season per earlier relic.
